topic: قاعدة 18 شهر — the honeymoon curve (limerence vs attachment)
«شكون الغالط؟» — accountability in a couple, both sides own their part (90/10 rule)
«لا قاصح، لا مسكين» — warm but firm: kindness + boundaries
«العقد القديم» — old roles vs today, mental load, write a new deal together
«شكون كيقود العلاقة؟» — leadership = initiative + listening, not control; whoever is better at something leads it
«جوج أنواع ديال البعاد» — space that invites back (name the time, come back) vs السكات العقابي; both sexes
«الخوف من الخسارة» — fear of loss → clinging pushes away; التعلق المرضي vs secure love; check fear: reality or past
«الميزان» — the one who gives alone burns out; العبء الذهني vs expenses; balance effort, don't keep score
«شكون كيهدّن الآخر؟» — one explodes, one calms; تنظيم المشاعر: calm yourself first, 3 steps; calm and panic are contagious
«تحت الضغط» — money/work stress: don't dump panic or shut down; share fear calmly with a plan, as a team
«الراحة قتلات الحب؟» — Too much comfort (pyjamas, phone, routine) kills spark; zero comfort kills safety. Need both: الأمان + شوية ديال الجديد.

topic: الضحك فالخصومة — Defuse small silly fights with humour (agree and exaggerate) instead of defending. Not for serious issues.
البرودة فالخصومة — Staying calm when the other shouts: don't match the volume. Breathe, lower your voice, answer later. Calm wins the argument.
المزيان بزاف — Being 'too nice' = saying yes to avoid conflict, hidden resentment. Kind ≠ no limits. Applies to girls too ('the nice girl').
كتراقب راسك بزاف — Over-thinking how you look/sound in front of your partner makes you stiff. Ease and being yourself is attractive.
